description: The close button of a tab was pressed. event.id, event.index and event.title name the tab. The row removes the tab from its own list and selects a neighbour if it was selected; the component's `selectedTabId` follows, and its `tabs` list keeps the tab until the page drops it.

id.description: The `id` of the tab whose close button was pressed.

index.description: The position the tab had in `tabs`, from 0.
